premise: A ring of mushrooms pops up in the grass, and Pinecone and Ladybug turn it into a dance floor, with Mushroom wiggling in the middle.
inspiration: The folk ring dance (the fairy ring), without the fairies: friends make their own magic in the circle.
lesson: Everyone can join the dance in their own way.

en-US.title: The Mushroom Ring Dance
en-US.text: One morning, a ring of mushrooms appeared in the grass, round as a plate. And Mushroom {mushroom:pulse} was right in the middle. [curious] What's it for? asked Pinecone {pinecone:hop}. I don't know, said Mushroom. But it looks like a dance floor! Ladybug {ladybug:hop x2} landed in the ring. [excited] Then let's dance! {sfx:drum} Pinecone {pinecone:wobble x2} rolled round the ring: roll, roll, roll. Ladybug {ladybug:hop x3} hopped from cap to cap: hop, hop, hop. And Mushroom {mushroom:wobble x2} wiggled right where she was, because mushrooms can't walk. [giggles] Roll, hop, wiggle! Roll, hop, wiggle! Faster and faster, round and round, until Pinecone {pinecone:spin} spun, and Ladybug {ladybug:spin} spun, and everybody tumbled down in a heap. [laughs] Again? said Mushroom. {mushroom:hearts} Again! said everyone.

es-ES.title: El baile del corro de setas
es-ES.text: Una mañana apareció en la hierba un corro de setas, redondo como un plato. Y Seta {mushroom:pulse} estaba justo en el centro. [curious] ¿Para qué es?, preguntó Piña {pinecone:hop}. No lo sé, dijo Seta. ¡Pero parece una pista de baile! Mariquita {ladybug:hop x2} aterrizó en el corro. [excited] ¡Pues a bailar! {sfx:drum} Piña {pinecone:wobble x2} rodaba alrededor del corro: rueda, rueda, rueda. Mariquita {ladybug:hop x3} saltaba de sombrero en sombrero: salta, salta, salta. Y Seta {mushroom:wobble x2} se meneaba sin moverse de su sitio, porque las setas no pueden andar. [giggles] ¡Rueda, salta, meneo! ¡Rueda, salta, meneo! Más deprisa, más deprisa, vuelta y vuelta, hasta que Piña {pinecone:spin} giró, y Mariquita {ladybug:spin} giró, y todas acabaron en un montón. [laughs] ¿Otra vez?, dijo Seta. {mushroom:hearts} ¡Otra vez!, dijeron todas.

drum.prompt: a light playful rhythm tapped on a hollow log, like a tiny forest drum
